# Women's IP Alliance (WIPA)

WIPA is an international membership community for women across intellectual property — 
patents, trademarks, copyright, and innovation. It offers global networking, mentorship, 
educational webinars, a job board, and a digital community platform. Membership tiers: 
IP Professional, Entrepreneur, and Student. Founded by the team behind The Women's IP 
World Annual. Launching January 2027.

Offices: London/Dover, UK and Ahmedabad, India.
